metas.name: Photographer
metas.description: Veera, a troubled, obsessive photographer seeking validation, travels deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious forest reserve, to photograph a rare, elusive phenomenon that could transform his life.

metas.name: The Silence of Swastika
metas.description: Hitler used a symbol for his political and racial ideology. The world today calls that symbol "Swastika", an Indian name to a symbol used by Hindus, Buddhists, and Jains for ages. But was it a Swastika? or Something else?

metas.name: Modha Rathiri
metas.description: Follows two strangers brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Forrest Gump
metas.description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

metas.name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Thani Oruvan
metas.description: Siddharth Abimanyu, an influential scientist, is involved in various illegal medical practices. Mithran, an efficient IPS officer, decides to expose him.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: Your Name.
metas.description: Two teenagers share a profound, magical connection upon discovering they are swapping bodies. Things manage to become even more complicated when the boy and girl decide to meet in person.

metas.name: 3 Idiots
metas.description: Two friends are searching for their long lost companion. They revisit their college days and recall the memories of their friend who inspired them to think differently, even as the rest of the world called them "idiots".

metas.name: Raatchasan
metas.description: A sub-inspector sets out in pursuit of a mysterious serial killer who targets teen school girls and murders them brutally.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Anniyan
metas.description: Ramanujam, who suffers from multiple personality disorder, works as a lawyer by day and a vigilante at night, using tips from the 'Garuda Purana' as his tools to punish various antisocial elements.

metas.name: Dangal
metas.description: Mahavir Singh Phogat, a former wrestler, decides to fulfill his dream of winning a gold medal for his country by training his daughters for the Commonwealth Games despite the existing social stigmas.

metas.name: Maheshinte Prathikaaram
metas.description: Mahesh, a studio photographer and studio owner gets into a fight and loses. He ends up taking revenge which leads to certain realizations in his life.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: Two US marshals are sent to a mental institution on an inhospitable island in order to investigate the disappearance of a patient.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: Barfi!
metas.description: Three young people learn that love can neither be defined nor contained by society's definition of normal and abnormal.

metas.name: Iqbal
metas.description: Iqbal, the deaf and mute son of a farmer, has a passion for the game of cricket and seeks the tutelage of a washed-up, alcoholic ex-player.

metas.name: Leader
metas.description: A political leader's educated son aims to fix a corrupt system of favors, but gets caught in power plays. He must find his way through political maneuvering to reach his goals.

metas.name: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
metas.description: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

metas.name: Malik
metas.description: A past ridden with crime, death and pain is recounted to Freddy, a juvenile criminal, who has been assigned to eliminate his estranged uncle Sulaiman, an aging patriarch, while behind bars.

metas.name: Slumdog Millionaire
metas.description: When a teenager from the slums of Mumbai is interrogated about his suspicious performance on a quiz show, he revisits various events from his past to explain how he knew all the answers.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

metas.name: The Pursuit of Happyness
metas.description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: Baron "Bear" Bailey breaks a novelty charm to force his co-worker Nikki Freeman to love him, but the supernatural compulsion warps her mind into violent obsession, trapping him in a nightmare he cannot wish away.

metas.name: Arjun Reddy
metas.description: Arjun Reddy, a short-tempered house surgeon, gets used to drugs and drinks when his girlfriend is forced to marry another person.

metas.name: Johnny Gaddaar
metas.description: Police officers recount a tale of missing money which results in lies, deceit, betrayal and death.

metas.name: My Name Is Khan
metas.description: Rizwan Khan is a Muslim immigrant to the US with Asperger's syndrome. After his family falls apart in the aftermath of 9/11, he begins an epic quest across the country to speak to the President of the United States and clear his n...

metas.name: Article 370
metas.description: Ahead of a major constitutional decision, special agent Zooni Haksar is tasked with a secret mission to quell violence in a conflict-ridden region.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!
metas.description: Lovinder Singh, a thief now in custody and facing trial, reflects on his life of crime while the press reflect on how he managed to get away with so much before being arrested.

metas.name: Shiddat
metas.description: A passionate love story involving two couples which highlights the contrast between a regular, mature yet egoistic husband and a unique, happy go lucky, enamored, overzealous boy chasing after the love of his life.

metas.name: Mahaan
metas.description: Gandhi Mahaan, a school teacher, is abandoned by his family after he decides to live a life of his own, with personal freedom.

metas.name: The Whale
metas.description: A reclusive, morbidly obese English teacher attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter.

metas.name: Irumbu Thirai
metas.description: A soldier takes on a gang of cyber criminals when money goes missing from his account.

metas.name: Manorama: Six Feet Under
metas.description: Manorama, wife of an irrigation minister, tasks Satyaveer to find if her husband is cheating. As Satyaveer starts investigating, he gets trapped in a web of lies and must uncover the entire truth.

metas.name: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
metas.description: Robert Ford, who has idolized Jesse James since childhood, tries hard to join the resurgent gang of the Missouri outlaw, but gradually becomes resentful of the bandit leader.

metas.name: OMG 2
metas.description: An unhappy civilian asks the court to mandate comprehensive education in schools in a dramatic yet amusing courtroom play.

metas.name: To Father with Love
metas.description: An intelligent son of a former entrepreneur takes revenge on a powerful and rich businessman who is as smart as he is.

metas.name: Bandit Queen
metas.description: The story of the bandit queen Phoolan Devi who was sent to prison in 1983 and got free in 1994.

metas.name: Devdas
metas.description: After his wealthy family prohibits him from marrying the woman he is in love with, Devdas Mukherjee's life spirals further and further out of control as he takes up alcohol and a life of vice to numb the pain.

metas.name: The Judge
metas.description: Big-city lawyer Hank Palmer returns to his childhood home where his father, the town's judge, is suspected of murder. Hank sets out to discover the truth; along the way he reconnects with his estranged family.

metas.name: Ghajini
metas.description: A short-term memory loss patient goes on a killing spree in order to avenge the death of his ladylove.

metas.name: Attarintiki Daredi
metas.description: The scion of a powerful family is tasked with retrieving an estranged family member.

metas.name: Welcome
metas.description: A man falls in love with a beautiful woman, but later discovers that her brothers are gangsters.

metas.name: Luck by Chance
metas.description: When Vikram gets tapped to play the male lead in a Bollywood film, he can't believe his luck. But it may ruin his relationship with his girlfriend.
